name: Surge and inrush protection (MOVs, NTCs)
summary: Parts that soak up voltage spikes and inrush: MOVs, NTC thermistors, TVS diodes and gas tubes.
uses: Protecting a power system from lightning spikes
Repairing blown power supplies (MOVs often fail)
identify: Blue or orange disc MOVs (marked 10D471, 14D561) across the mains input, and black or green NTC discs (5D-11) in series with it, in surge strips, power supplies, TVs and appliances.
test: A MOV should read open on a meter; a burnt or cracked one is dead. NTCs read a few ohms when cold.

decay.note: Lasts until a big surge uses it up.
